title: Wiring evaluation into the continuous integration pipeline

videos.script: A check somebody has to remember to run is a check that does not run on the day it matters. {{remember}} So the set's checks and the regression become tests, run on every change that could alter a reply. {{tiers}} The set's tests call no model and cost nothing. The regression asks production and the candidate the same questions, in the same run. {{tests}} On the release of the second of October, one test fails, and its message names the five cases and the two ways out. {{history}} The fix fails too, on cost and speed, because production was cheap for a bad reason. {{budget}} So the decision goes into a file, with a ceiling and a reason, for that release alone. Then it passes. {{accepted}} And with no candidate named, the gate errors rather than skipping. A gate must not pass by not running. {{loud}}
